name: exposure
title: Exposure
description: What is really owned once every fund is looked through to what it holds, as of a date (default today). Views: classes; sectors (by class and sector); sizes (large, mid, small caps); countries (with region); currencies (the fiat currency, metal or coin a value moves with); credit (debt by rating bucket, IG or HY); maturities (debt and cash by time to maturity); coupons (fixed, floating, inflation_linked, zero); cycles (equity by cyclical, sensitive, defensive); situs (the country whose law each holding sits under; no fund looked through, so not exposure); securities (each security, direct and through funds); issuers (stock, bonds and deposits together, largest first, with the running share); funds (each fund held, what describes it and how old that is); coverage (what the figures rest on and what nothing describes). Every view sums to net worth: share_pct is of it; class_share_pct is within the row's dimension (its class on sectors and sizes; every row but (none) on credit, maturities, coupons, cycles), so those sum to 100. Read quality and coverage before trusting a figure. period with from/to: the view at the end of every month, quarter or year, in one call. Example: {view: "countries", as_of: "2025-12-31"}; quarter by quarter: {view: "countries", period: "quarterly", from: "2025", to: "2025", filter: ["country = US"]}.

benchmark.description: the benchmark's weight of each row and the row's share less it; not on situs, funds or coverage, and no period. One of Global 60/40, Global 80/20, S&P 500, US total bond market, World (ACWI), or a name from the config's benchmarks block.

country.description: countries and securities: the country a security counts in, risk (default) or domicile.

currency.description: Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

from.description: With period: the series' start (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday, last month, last year).

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

period.description: classes, sectors, sizes, countries, currencies, credit, maturities, coupons, cycles, situs and coverage: a series at the end of each period of from/to (default: the last twelve months).

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

to.description: With period: the series' end, same forms. Default today.
